eyebrow: What we say when you're cooked
title: The toasts.
lede: Same lines Chrome fires when you are about to rinse it. Catalog, not a live overlay.
metaDescription: The actual TiltCheck toast prompts: pace, chase, heater, drain. What we say when you are about to send the stack back.
honesty: These fire in Chrome. The wallet lock is Cooldown. The 2s brake is the extension.

items.text: No cap, the balance is still catching that last spin.

items.fire: Stake went up after a loss
items.text: No cap, the last one lost and this stake is bigger. That's the chase.
Looks like a heater. Lock half of this win? Skip anytime.
3 losses in a row. The RNG doesn't care about your feelings. Take a breather — we'll be here.
The house has officially entered its winning streak era. Revenge betting is their favorite thing. Don't give them the satisfaction.
You cannot outrun the math. We say this with love. Walk away with what you've got left.
Half your deposit in under 10 minutes. The math is currently beating you like a drum. Take 5 before you're eating ramen all week.
50% gone in 10 minutes is a speed problem, not a luck problem. Stop.
That's a big bet. Like, a real chunk of your bag. Just making sure that was on purpose.
Oh, doubling down again? Bold strategy. Let's see if it pays off. (Narrator: It won't.)
Three consecutive double-ups. That's not a strategy, that's a prayer. The math has no sympathy.
Three hours in. Your brain is cooked whether you feel it or not. Go eat something. We'll still be here.
Still here? The house noticed. They sent a thank-you card. Maybe cash out while you're ahead.
